title: Oodles the Talking Poodle
description: Oodles the Talking Poodle really uses his noodle. When there is trouble, he’ll come on the double. He’s one dog who knows his tricks.
quote: Come quick! Uncle Lyle’s locked in the barn again and it’s on fire!
altHero: Oodles, a pink poodle wearing a t-shirt and cape
alt1: Oodles jumping through a wood fence
alt4: Oodles punching a lock off a barn door
